Overview
This 6-week program is designed for sport climbers
with some experience with structured training that
would like to build a foundation of power endurance to
prepare for pumpy sport climbs. The template is
designed to be split across three training days per
week.
The first training day can be completed at a boulder
wall and should consist of the Warm Up, followed by
either Boulder Intervals (weeks 1 & 2), Style Triad
(Weeks 3 & 6), or Broken Quarters (weeks 4 & 5).
The second training day will consist of the Route Warm
Up Protocol followed by Route Pyramids (except for
week 3).
The third training day will consist of the Finger
Strength Testing Session on week 1 and then on the
remaining weeks will consist of 7:3s 50-60%
repeaters. The repeaters workouts can be done after
max strength fingerboarding, but should not be done
before strength training.
Additional sessions can be added to this plan to
maintain base endurance or strength & power.
